_comment: bashback hooks. Merge the hooks block into .claude/settings.json (project) or ~/.claude/settings.json (user). Replace /abs/path/to/bashback with the absolute path to the built binary. The Bash matcher scopes tool hooks to bash calls (post hooks add Monitor, whose commands reach the Bash pre hook); the TaskStop|Read matcher captures a backgrounded command's final state when the agent reads its finished output or stops it.
